text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 211 tablets of acyclovir 400 mg at 15.5 per day (13.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 339 vials of acyclovir sodium 500 mg/10 mL at 15.4 per day (22 days). Corvale East holds 502 vials at 13 per day (38.5 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 101 vials at 4.1 per day (24.8 days). The lowest coverage is 13.6 days at Corvale General for the tablet presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include acyclovir sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale General for the 400 mg tablet is below our internal comfort threshold. All ranked alternate manufacturers (Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., ProPharma Distribution, Slate Run Pharmaceuticals LLC) are not on FDA's shortage list today. Their labels name no plant we could place. Purchase orders must be checked against the 13.6-day site and Eugia US LLC availability confirmed before new orders are placed.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current purchase orders align with Corvale General's 13.6-day supply and confirms Eugia US LLC availability; buyer approves.
2. Buyer places orders with Eugia US LLC for the 400 mg tablet to replenish Corvale General; buyer approves, pharmacy director approves.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage at all three sites and updates days-on-hand weekly; buyer approves.
4. Buyer evaluates Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., ProPharma Distribution, and Slate Run Pharmaceuticals LLC as backup sources if Eugia US LLC cannot supply; buyer approves, pharmacy director approves.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
